prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one finished mobile-app background, opaque RGB PNG, exactly 1024 x 1536 pixels, portrait 2:3.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing home background and Image 2 is the existing kitchen background. BOTH ARE STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Generate a completely new illustration, not a resized, cropped, blurred or zoomed version of either reference.
Style: match the reference's confident fine wax-crayon outlines, opaque matte ivory coloring, restrained mint green, pale honey wood, light warm charcoal-brown lines and gentle paper grain. Preserve clear recognizable edges at phone size. No watercolor blur, heavy scribble, photorealism, 3D, gloss, depth-of-field blur, vignette, frame or border.
Scene: an ingredient preparation and storage corner. Two small low wooden work units at the bottom corners with two plain cream storage jars, one small basket and a folded mint cloth. All jars are blank, with no labels or symbols. A little potted plant may sit on one unit. Keep every jar, basket and piece of furniture fully visible inside the canvas with margins. No oversized jars and no cropped shelves. The center and upper three quarters remain an open pale ivory wall.
Composition: calm straight-on wide room view. Huge uninterrupted pale ivory wall, especially x=12%..88%, y=0%..74%, for existing foreground app cards and text. Keep side decoration sparse, fine and subordinate. The floor may occupy the lowest 20%. Background should remain coherent as the complete 2:3 image is shown with contain on narrow phones and wide tablets.
Lighting: warm soft daylight, airy, crisp, friendly and consistent with both reference artworks. Keep the central wall very light and low texture for 4.5:1 readable live app text after a subtle 16% cream veil. Do not pre-apply a fog or translucent wash to the whole image.
Text: NONE. No people, Jango mascot, animals, faces, letters, numbers, labels, calendars, displays, settings gears, functional icons, logos, watermark or UI elements.
reason: Main furniture or decorative plants still cropped at canvas boundaries; not adopted.
